name: opensidekick
description: Open-source, provider-agnostic AI browser agent Chrome extension. Bring your own LLM.

scripts.check: for f in $(git ls-files '*.js' '*.mjs'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'all JS OK'
scripts.test:unit: node test/providers.test.mjs && node test/convert.test.mjs && node test/safety.test.mjs && node test/plan.test.mjs && node test/prompts.test.mjs && node test/mcp.test.mjs && node test/migrations.test.mjs && node test/testmodel.test.mjs && node test/permissions.test.mjs && node test/venice.test.mjs && node test/decisions.test.mjs && node test/presets.test.mjs && node test/sessions.test.mjs && node test/model-test-messages.test.mjs && node test/markdown.test.mjs && node test/vendor.test.mjs && node test/firefox-build.test.mjs
scripts.zip: rm -f opensidekick.zip && zip -r opensidekick.zip manifest.json src icons LICENSE -x '*.DS_Store'
